map.按某列排序：对「名字,分数」这类带分隔的行，按第二列数值排。: Sort by a column: for delimiter-separated rows like "name,score", sort by the numeric value of the second column.

map.可指定逗号/制表符/空格；多空格建议用制表符或先规范分隔，否则列识别会错位。: You can specify comma/tab/space; for multiple spaces use a tab or normalize first, otherwise column detection misaligns.
map.普通排序把『10』当『1』『0』排在『2』前；自然排序识别数字整体，『2、10、: Plain sorting treats "10" as "1" "0" and puts it before "2"; natural sort recognizes the whole number, so "2, 10, 100" order correctly, ideal for file names and numbering.
